scope: Exact source/receipt archive and native boards. Generic frozen reporter wording H1/aggregation is inherited; this experiment compares neural nuisance/conditional H1 with global masks, not phase aggregation or historical-mask equivalence.
status: complete; useful low-prior weak-increment-error operating point, limited development evidence
quality_decision: Retain analytic Hann512 as an opt-in lower weak-increment error choice; keep256 fixed-NN alternative for stronger strong-family response/lower total RGB error. No broad photo/camera/default promotion.
scope_clarification: Inherited plan window-ablation sentence says other fitting rules unchanged; declared geometry.frequency_weighting and study.json explicitly change analytic frequency grid/refinement to Hann inverse-variance conditional WLS. Amplitude/validation/parent delivery remain unchanged. Current producer adds this wording explicitly for future plans; executed source/plan bytes preserved.
